cards.title: Want in early? Here's how.
cards.body: AICA is at MVP stage with pilots starting in Lucknow. Whether you're a family, a chemist or a clinic, there's a way to get involved.

cards.title: Step 1: visit aicaglobal.in
cards.body: That's home to the interactive prototype and the waitlist. AICA isn't in app stores yet, so the website is where to start.

cards.title: Step 2: try the prototype
cards.body: Click through how scanning, reminders and family profiles are meant to work. It's the quickest way to see if AICA fits your family.

cards.title: Step 3: join the waitlist
cards.body: Add yourself to the waitlist to hear when there's more to try. Nothing is charged today.

cards.title: Chemists and clinics: the pilot
cards.body: Founding pharmacies and clinics use AICA free during the pilot in Lucknow. Start with the waitlist at aicaglobal.in.

cards.title: Your data is respected from sign-up
cards.body: Consent is asked at sign-up, your data is never sold, and you can download or delete it.

cards.title: Early users shape what gets built
cards.body: Join now and help make AICA fit real Lucknow families and counters. It all starts at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: Visit aicaglobal.in, try the prototype and join the waitlist. Founding pharmacies and clinics can join the free Lucknow pilot.
share: AICA's waitlist is open at aicaglobal.in. Free pilot for founding chemists and clinics in Lucknow.
